features.name: molecular_complexity_score
features.description: Composite molecular complexity combining atom count proxy (V1), branching (V7), and ring-related features (V3). Higher values indicate more complex molecular structures.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree splits on this composite can separate simple vs complex molecules which often differ in biodegradability

features.name: polarity_asymmetry
features.description: Absolute difference between two polarity-related descriptors V12 and V14, capturing asymmetry in charge distribution. Large values indicate highly polar or asymmetric molecules.
features.expected_model_benefit: Polarity asymmetry is a key driver of biodegradability; tree thresholds on this can isolate polar vs nonpolar compounds

features.name: heteroatom_density
features.description: Ratio of heteroatom-related count (V9 + V6) to molecular size proxy V1. Higher density suggests more reactive functional groups.
features.expected_model_benefit: Heteroatom density directly relates to biodegradability pathways; enables clean threshold splits

features.name: aromatic_fraction
features.description: Fraction of aromatic-related atoms (V5) relative to total atom count proxy (V16 + V5 + 1). Captures aromaticity level of the molecule.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aromatic compounds tend to be less biodegradable; this fraction enables direct boolean splits

features.name: log_molecular_weight_proxy
features.description: Log-transformed proxy for molecular weight using V39 (a size-related descriptor). Compresses the heavy tail of large molecules.
features.expected_model_benefit: Log-transformed size features provide better split points for tree models on skewed distributions

features.name: connectivity_ratio
features.description: Ratio of two topological connectivity indices V2 and V13. Captures relative branching and connectivity structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Connectivity ratio captures structural topology differences that tree models can exploit with threshold splits

features.name: has_nitrogen_oxygen_groups
features.description: Boolean indicator (0/1) for presence of nitrogen or oxygen functional groups based on V4 > 0 or V20 > 0. Indicates reactive heteroatom groups.
features.expected_model_benefit: Boolean indicator enables direct binary splits; nitrogen/oxygen groups strongly influence biodegradation pathways

features.name: ring_complexity_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket (0-3) for ring system complexity based on V3 count: 0=no rings, 1=1 ring, 2=2-3 rings, 3=4+ rings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ordinal ring buckets allow tree models to split on ring complexity levels directly without numeric noise

features.name: electrotopological_interaction
features.description: Product of electrotopological state V36 and V37, capturing nonlinear interaction between two electrotopological descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Nonlinear interaction term captures joint effects that individual features miss; tree models benefit from pre-computed interactions

features.name: molecular_flexibility_index
features.description: Ratio of rotatable bond count proxy (V10) to total heavy atom count proxy (V1). Higher values indicate more flexible molecules.
features.expected_model_benefit: Molecular flexibility affects biodegradation rate; this ratio normalizes for molecule size enabling better splits

features.name: halogen_presence_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of halogen-related structural features based on V26 (halogen count proxy) and V29 (halogen indicator). Score 0=no halogens, 1=low halogen content, 2=moderate, 3=high halogen content. Halogens strongly reduce biodegradability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Halogen content is a strong predictor of biodegradability resistance; ordinal score enables direct tree splits

features.name: descriptor_deviation_from_mean
features.description: Standardized deviation of V8 (a key physicochemical descriptor) from its training mean (37.06), normalized by training std (9.14). Captures how atypical a molecule is on this descriptor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Deviation from typical values identifies outlier molecules; tree thresholds on deviation can isolate unusual compounds with distinct biodegradability
